components.name: Daily and Sports Activities (UCI)
components.sensor: Xsens MTx (acc m/s^2 -> g, gyro rad/s -> deg/s)
components.calibration_emulation: per subject, standing segment a02/s01 = neutral pose; removed from training and evaluation

components.name: PAMAP2 Physical Activity Monitoring (UCI), ankle IMU
components.sensor: Colibri IMU, ankle (acc16 m/s^2 -> g, gyro rad/s -> deg/s)
components.calibration_emulation: first 10 s of each subject's first standing recording = neutral pose; removed from training and evaluation
